description: Archive up to 100 products — this is how an AI client removes a product. It leaves sale and every sales channel's feed, and nothing is erased: update_product with status active or draft restores it. Hard deletion is not available over MCP. Archiving also asks Prom to take the product's listings down; notAttempted counts takedowns not reached in time. To end a live eBay listing use withdraw_ebay_listings. Returns { affected, skipped, notAttempted } — skipped products were already archived. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: The products to archive, at most 100 ids from search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
